Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
let today = new Date();
let dd = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
let mm = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
let yy = String(today.getFullYear()).substring(2);

today = dd + "/" + mm + "/" + yy;

alert("Today's Date : " + today);

let name = prompt("Enter your name : ");
alert("Hello " + name);

let nums = prompt("Enter two numbers (space seperated) :");

let sum = Number(nums.split(" ")[0]) + Number(nums.split(" ")[1]);

alert("Sum is : " + sum);
